finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I believe there is someone more qualified than I to speak on it,” the Sword Saint said as he reached out and touched the necklace. He infused some energy into it with the intent of waking up the soul slumbering within.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “If you want to reach a goal, you must set one in your mind first. I do not call myself that because I believe myself qualified right now, but because I strive to one day be worthy,” the Sword Saint answered honestly.
